methodological_rigor.justification: Bioinformatics study using TCGA + GSE7390 datasets. Differential expression analysis with enrichment pathway analysis. Nomogram construction standard methodology. Limited to computational approach without experimental validation. Gene expression validation (RT-qPCR) on small subset.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Computational model development from public databases. Nomogram provides prognostic value but requires independent clinical validation. Limited translational demonstration.

reporting_quality.justification: Gene sources (TCGA, GEO) clearly identified. However, limited detail on statistical methods for DEG selection, enrichment analysis cutoffs, or model selection criteria. Nomogram methodology standard but incompletely described.

novelty_literature.justification: HER2-related prognostic models previously developed. Eight-gene signature adds modest novelty. Computational integration without new biological mechanism.

writing_presentation.justification: Organized presentation of bioinformatics workflow. Results clearly tabulated. Discussion brief without substantial biological interpretation.

key_strengths: Integration of TCGA and GSE7390 datasets
Eight-gene prognostic signature with nomogram visualization
key_concerns: Computational model development without clinical implementation study
Limited biological insight into gene selections; pathway enrichment results not mechanistically explored
Nomogram performance on held-out test set not reported; potential overfitting
Gene selection methodology not clearly stated (cut-offs for |log2FC|, p-values)
chief_reviewer.rationale: Computational prognostic model requiring prospective external validation before clinical utility. Appropriate for tier 4 pending independent cohort evaluation.
